theorem mvcc.CmpRecs.schedRev_getD (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : sint.Z (r.sched.getD (W64 0)) = r.schedRev

theorem mvcc.restoreCur_cut (R : mvcc.Log) (hR : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ R → cs ≠ []) (hRne
    : R ≠ []) (hb : mvcc.LogB ([[], []] ++ R)) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (hrec : mvcc.recsOk ([[], []] ++
    R) r) (ents : List mvcc.KvEnt) (hcut : mvcc.entsCutAt ([[], []] ++ R) r.crev ents) : max (max
    (sint.Z (mvcc.restoreLastRev ents)) r.finRev) r.schedRev = ↑([[], []] ++ R).length - 1

theorem mvcc.entsFromE_next (L : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB L) {ents : List mvcc.KvEnt} (hs :
    ents.Sublist (mvcc.logEnts L 0 (List.length L))) (r : mvcc.Rev) (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (e :
    mvcc.KvEnt) (he : (mvcc.entsFromE ents r)[n - 1]? = some e) : mvcc.entsFromE ents (mvcc.revNext
    e.rev) = List.drop n (mvcc.entsFromE ents r)

theorem mvcc.CmpRecs.finRev_getD (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : sint.Z (r.fin.getD (W64 (-1))) = r.finRev

theorem mvcc.logEnts_two : mvcc.logEnts [[], []] 0 2 = []

theorem mvcc.restoreCur_cut_nil (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (hrec : mvcc.recsOk [[], []] r) (ents : List
    mvcc.KvEnt) (hcut : mvcc.entsCutAt [[], []] r.crev ents) : max (max (sint.Z (mvcc.restoreLastRev
    ents)) r.finRev) r.schedRev = ↑[[], []].length - 1

theorem mvcc.bucketRange_fromE (L : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB L) {ents : List mvcc.KvEnt} (hs :
    ents.Sublist (mvcc.logEnts L 0 (List.length L))) (r : mvcc.Rev) : mvcc.bucketRange
    (mvcc.bucketOfEnts ents) (mvcc.revBytes r false) (mvcc.revBytes mvcc.revMax false) = List.map
    mvcc.KvEnt.pair (mvcc.entsFromE ents r)

theorem mvcc.restoreOk_sublist {l l' : List mvcc.KvEnt} (h : mvcc.RestoreEntsOk l) (hs : l'.Sublist
    l) : mvcc.RestoreEntsOk l'

theorem mvcc.bucketOfEnts_lookup_iff (L : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB L) {ents : List mvcc.KvEnt} (hs
    : ents.Sublist (mvcc.logEnts L 0 (List.length L))) (k v : GoString) : mvcc.bucketOfEnts ents !!
    k = some v ↔ (k, v) ∈ List.map mvcc.KvEnt.pair ents

theorem mvcc.pairwise_getLast {α : Type} {R : α → α → Prop} {l : List α} (hs : List.Pairwise R l) {x
    e : α} (hx : x ∈ l) (he : l.getLast? = some e) : x = e ∨ R x e

def mvcc.entsFromE (ents : List mvcc.KvEnt) (r : mvcc.Rev) : List mvcc.KvEnt :=
  List.filter (fun e => decide (mvcc.revLeN r e.rev)) ents

theorem mvcc.CmpRecs.crev_ge (L : mvcc.Log) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (h : mvcc.recsOk L r) : -1 ≤ r.crev

theorem mvcc.logEnts_main_le (L : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB L) (e : mvcc.KvEnt) (he : e ∈
    mvcc.logEnts L 0 (List.length L)) : sint.Z e.rev.main ≤ ↑(List.length L) - 1

theorem mvcc.CmpRecs.crev_le_max (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) : r.crev ≤ max r.finRev r.schedRev

theorem mvcc.restoreCur_cut' (R : mvcc.Log) (hR : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ R → cs ≠ []) (hb :
    mvcc.LogB ([[], []] ++ R)) (r : mvcc.CmpRecs) (hrec : mvcc.recsOk ([[], []] ++ R) r) (ents :
    List mvcc.KvEnt) (hcut : mvcc.entsCutAt ([[], []] ++ R) r.crev ents) : max (max (sint.Z
    (mvcc.restoreLastRev ents)) r.finRev) r.schedRev = ↑([[], []] ++ R).length - 1

theorem mvcc.entsFromE_one (L : mvcc.Log) (hb : mvcc.LogB L) (h0 : List.getD L 0 [] = []) {ents :
    List mvcc.KvEnt} (hs : ents.Sublist (mvcc.logEnts L 0 (List.length L))) : mvcc.entsFromE ents {
    main := W64 1, sub := W64 0 } = ents

theorem mvcc.bucketOfEnts_logEnts (L : mvcc.Log) : mvcc.bucketOfEnts (mvcc.logEnts L 0 (List.length
    L)) = mvcc.bucketMap L
